fact: The BEMA integrated judicial management software, built by the company JBSOFT Gabon with magistrates and court officers, was officially presented at a seminar in Libreville on 10 January 2026: its designer says police, court and prison currently work in isolation with information re-keyed, and that in BEMA the judicial police officer enters the procedure, the system generates the procès-verbal and the file passes digitally to the court, on ANINF's secure network; no deployment in any police unit is stated.
title: Procédures judiciaires lentes : la solution ‘’BEMA’’ pour braver les obstacles
